sources.beginner: nextgen-panel src/components/course/panels/fluid/CorrelationExplorer.jsx (embedded in src/content/courses/fluid/beginner/m06-the-associate-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md, "The panel runs all of them"); its editable inputs default to the Ekene capstone state, so all six print on load at 1-7 decimals. Hand-calc is possible for the Standing/Beal closed forms but HY/DAK z are iterative; no Suite studio named.
sources.intermediate: nextgen-panel src/components/course/panels/fluid/StudyExplorer.jsx (embedded in src/content/courses/fluid/intermediate/m06-the-professional-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md): fixed Good Oil No. 4 study vs untuned PR EOS; C7+ Tc in the Composition view, model values and errors in "What the model says", 1-2 decimals.
sources.advanced: nextgen-panel src/components/course/panels/fluid/TuningExplorer.jsx (embedded in src/content/courses/fluid/advanced/m06-the-expert-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md): runs the tuneToLab regression itself; tuned psat/GOR/API and reduction on the default ledger view (3 decimals), knobs in "The knobs" view (6 decimals).

fields.evidence: fmt(r.pbAtRs, 1) in the Standing row prints 1,912.2; |1912.2 - 1912.1923| = 0.0077 <= tol 0.05. tol equals half a unit of the printed decimal, so the printed value always passes.
fields.notes: tol 0.05 is exactly half a unit of the one printed decimal: honest but with no margin. Possible LEAK: the panel's DEFAULT state is exactly the capstone case (EKENE constants, fluidLab.js:56-65), so this answer is on screen before the learner touches anything (probe: '1,912.2'). The capstone lesson embeds the panel and says 'The panel runs all of them', so it is the intended source; the field tests reading the right tile/row, not computing.

rekey_annot.evidence: The story-so-far and working lessons printed every answer and the correlation explorer opened on the Ekene oil. Re-cased on a stated second oil the learner types.
